label: Refined reviewed structural food pairing model

dishes.name: Green salad with vinaigrette
dishes.description: A light salad whose dressing makes acidity the main constraint.

dishes.name: Roast chicken with mushrooms
dishes.description: Moderate richness, poultry protein, and earthy umami.

dishes.name: Duck breast with cherry sauce
dishes.description: Rich poultry with a lightly sweet fruit sauce.

dishes.name: Grilled beef
dishes.description: A powerful grilled protein with fat, salt, and umami.

dishes.name: Grilled salmon with lemon
dishes.description: Rich fish with a material citrus-acidity constraint.

dishes.name: Spiced lamb tagine
dishes.description: Rich lamb with aromatic spice and mild sweetness; heat is adjustable.

dishes.name: Tomato pasta
dishes.description: A medium-weight dish dominated by tomato acidity and savoury character.

dishes.name: Mushroom risotto
dishes.description: Creamy texture with pronounced mushroom umami.

dishes.name: Aged hard cheese
dishes.description: An intense, fatty, salty, and umami-rich cheese.

dishes.name: Fruit tart
dishes.description: A sweet dessert; the wine must be at least as sweet as the dish.

dishes.name: Custom dish
dishes.description: A neutral starting point. Adjust the structure below to describe the actual recipe.

dishes.name: Raw vegetables or crudités
dishes.description: A very light, crisp vegetable dish with modest acidity and almost no richness.

dishes.name: Grilled vegetables with herbs
dishes.description: Moderate char, olive-oil richness, and savoury vegetables without heavy protein.

dishes.name: Oysters or raw shellfish
dishes.description: Delicate seafood dominated by salinity, freshness, and tannin sensitivity.

dishes.name: White fish with butter sauce
dishes.description: Delicate fish made richer by a butter or cream sauce.

dishes.name: Sushi or sashimi
dishes.description: Delicate raw fish with salty soy, seasoned rice, and a strong tannin constraint.

dishes.name: Chicken with cream sauce
dishes.description: Mild poultry with substantial creamy richness and modest savoury depth.

dishes.name: Roast pork
dishes.description: Moderately powerful roast meat with fat, protein, and browned savoury flavours.

dishes.name: Charcuterie or cured meat
dishes.description: Fatty, salty, savoury cured meat with substantial flavour intensity.

dishes.name: Slow-cooked beef stew
dishes.description: A powerful, rich, protein-heavy dish with concentrated slow-cooked umami.

dishes.name: Roast lamb with herbs
dishes.description: Rich, aromatic red meat with firm protein and restrained spice.

dishes.name: Game or venison stew
dishes.description: Intense lean game with concentrated savoury slow-cooked flavours.

dishes.name: Creamy pasta
dishes.description: Medium-intensity pasta whose cream or cheese makes richness the main constraint.

dishes.name: Seafood risotto
dishes.description: Creamy rice with seafood salinity, umami, and tannin sensitivity.

dishes.name: Tomato and cheese pizza
dishes.description: Tomato acidity combined with melted-cheese fat, salt, and umami.

dishes.name: Mild coconut curry
dishes.description: A rich, aromatic curry with coconut sweetness and moderate chilli heat.

dishes.name: Hot chilli curry
dishes.description: An intense curry where chilli heat creates a material alcohol and tannin risk.

dishes.name: Soft creamy cheese
dishes.description: A creamy, fatty cheese with moderate salt, intensity, and umami.

dishes.name: Blue cheese
dishes.description: A very intense, salty, fatty, and umami-rich cheese.

dishes.name: Chocolate dessert
dishes.description: An intense, rich, very sweet dessert that requires a genuinely sweet wine.

dishes.name: Crème brûlée or custard dessert
dishes.description: A rich custard dessert with pronounced sweetness and caramelised intensity.

dishes.name: Fresh fruit
dishes.description: A light dessert where fruit acidity and sweetness both matter.
